info.name: Echo Web API (Express)
info.description:
Every /api route of web/backend-express, the Express port of the Kotlin Echo Web server.

Setup
1. cd web/backend-express && npm install && npm run dev (serves http://127.0.0.1:8080 unless PORT is set).
2. If you change PORT, update `baseUrl` in the collection variables.
3. Set `username` and `password` to a real asmr.one account, and replace the sample ids with real ones.
4. Run the folders top to bottom. Account > Login comes first and Cleanup > Logout last. Home, Library or Search must run before Open feed and Page. Playlist editing > Create must run before the other editing requests. Tracks > Media must run before Proxy.

Notes
- Requests that reach asmr.one need network access and a working upstream.
- Login stores the session on the server, so no Authorization header is needed.
- Playlist editing changes only the playlist that Create made. Like, Settings and Logout change saved state on the server.
